extDescription.message: Convert files 100% offline: images, DOCX, PDF, JSON/CSV/XML, Markdown, OCR, plain-background removal & auto-convert on download.

needTwoPdfs.message: At least 2 PDF files are needed

jsonInputTitle.message: Paste JSON or load a data file
